question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enterpreneur"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "***Entrepreneur***".

 
 
• **Example: **He is a successful ***entrepreneur*** who started his own tech company.
 
 
 
• **Entrepreneur** (उद्यमी): A person who sets up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.
 
 
• **Example: **The*** entrepreneur*** launched a new startup focused on renewable energy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disseminate** (प्रसारित करना): Spread or disperse something, especially information, widely.

 
 
• **Example:** The organization aims to **disseminate** information about the importance of mental health.
 
 
 
• **Dilemma** (दुविधा): A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.
 
 
• **Example:** She faced a moral **dilemma** about whether to tell the truth or keep the secret.
 
 
 
• **Accommodate** (समायोजित करना): Provide lodging or sufficient space for.
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel can **accommodate** up to 500 guests.
